kinds.name: Envoy
kinds.description: Carries the house's word abroad. Treating with a foreign power needs an envoy standing on their soil — stances, tribute, and the sale of whole towns all pass through his hands.

kinds.name: Informer
kinds.description: Eyes inside foreign walls: reveals what the fog hides, and when the army storms a town he has already unbarred more than one gate. Watchful governors hunt him.

kinds.name: Hired Blade
kinds.description: A quiet solution to a loud problem. Sent against a general, a governor, or a king; bodyguards and food-tasters are the only argument he respects. Failure tends to be final.
